sources.title: Accurate and Efficient Lighting for Skinned Models
read_scope: Section 6: evaluation assumptions and evidence scope
sources.inspection: Original PDF retrieved and text read. Physical pages 4–6 rendered and viewed locally; no video viewed.
sources.supports: Face-derived and vertex-averaged gradients, additional zero-position influences, tangent transport, precomputed factors, reference-bone differences, and limits of capping.
sources.limits: Paper cotangent/Voronoi preprocessing not reproduced; no supplement/code inspected or executed; historical visual and operation-count claims not adopted as new or contemporary evidence.

claims.finding: Variable weights add outer-product terms even with translation-only transforms.
Preserve the supplied shading normal through a compatible tangent plane, rather than replacing it with geometric normals.
Face-affine weights with zero normal derivative. Article independently expands this as an explicit2×2 Gram solve.
Neighborhood estimate and additional zero-position influences. Article deliberately uses equal face averaging, not the paper cotangent/Voronoi weighting.
Precompute directional coefficients; complete partition-of-unity gives zero sums and reference differences.
Original implementation recipe and historical capping. Article chooses complete-influence capacity rejection, not silent trimming or a universal c=.9 guarantee.

claims.locator: Article preprocessing, orientation, two explicit examples and failure policies
claims.finding: Equal averaging, Gram solve, normal-only helper basis, cof(J) orientation, data lifecycle and examples are explicit editorial derivations/design choices, not claimed execution of the supplemental program.
